**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo `internal/filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go` (compile), `parser.go`/`ir.go` (dialect-agnostic condition tree), `schema.go`, `render.go` (SQL rendering). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled once into a dialect-agnostic `Condition` IR, then each driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, <Dialect>, &where, &args)` with `DialectSQLite` / `DialectPostgres` / `DialectMySQL` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`), and the renderer emits dialect-specific SQL fragments + placeholder args (e.g. JSON extraction and date-part expressions branch per dialect in `internal/filter/render.go:230-241,364-408`). API-side the string is validated first via `APIV1Service.validateFilter` (`server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:336`, called from `memo_service.go:211`).

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row plus comment-memo rows), `memo_relation`, `attachment`, and `memo_share`. Explicit cascade code lives in `store/memo.go:140-158` (relations + attachments) and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577` (comment memos). `memo_share` goes away via the SQL `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:108`, `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`) — note that on SQLite the DSN sets `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so that cascade is not enforced there. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `web/dist` is copied into `server/router/frontend/dist` and compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*`, then served by Echo's `middleware.StaticWithConfig` plus an SPA fallback middleware. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed), `:41-60` (`FrontendService.Serve`, `getFileSystem` :115, `spaFallbackMiddleware` :63); invoked from `server/server.go:72`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign.Runner — server/server.go:158-168: RunOnce at startup, then Run() on a time.Ticker of 12h (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
internal/webhook async workers — 4 goroutines started by package init(), driven by a buffered channel (queue depth 128), not a schedule (internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-55)
```
Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron-expression job scheduler — `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`) is referenced **only** by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`); the server never uses it. Likewise `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14-24`) is never constructed — only its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:151-176`, attached to the Connect transport at `:180-185`. Tokens it manages: a short-lived JWT **access token** (`Authorization: Bearer …`, held in memory/localStorage and shared across tabs via BroadcastChannel — `web/src/auth-state.ts`), refreshed proactively when near expiry and reactively on `Unauthenticated`, using a **refresh token** sent as an httpOnly cookie (`credentials: "include"`, `web/src/connect.ts:57-62`) via `AuthService.RefreshToken`. The backend also accepts **Personal Access Tokens**. Validation: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go` — `AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2`, `AuthenticateByRefreshToken`, `AuthenticateByPAT`; `server/auth/token.go`), driven by `Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go:34-58`, hooked in as the gateway middleware and Connect `NewAuthInterceptor` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66-90,135`.

```
memo created:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called from memo_service.go:157)
memo updated:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook        — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called from memo_update_helpers.go:67, reached by UpdateMemo / SetMemoRelations / SetMemoAttachments)
memo deleted:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook        — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called from memo_service.go:562)
memo comment created:  APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called from memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three funnel through `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:48`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), which enqueues to the async worker pool that calls `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`) for the actual HTTP delivery.
